facts.fact: 噩梦循环（本章床上无花）：骨宫庭院编织命线欲一举终战→Jas 被 Deia 之火吞；持 Samhara 面对王绝境→Jas 黑蛋白石之剑+最后一笑「Don’t waste it」——醒来只有坟土味。
facts.anchor: Risha woke with a gasp and the chill of her torus spinning around her.

facts.fact: 今日春分：palace square 是悼者圣地，怎么清场开门？「We need you to figure out how to best kill a god」的派工言犹在耳；她自认毫无准备。
柜中 Valentin 毒舌开场（decided on a trim / Looks awful）；Risha 开条件：助我毁 Thana→还你身体；Jas 警告「Don’t make this promise...he’s always scheming」；她回敬「And I can’t scheme back?」。
facts.anchor: “I see you’ve decided on a trim.”

facts.fact: fulcrum 谜底推进：Thana 把 withering core 分给四王——在身体还是灵魂？Valentin 答「yes and no」→承认为每人分了 core；Risha 结论：「the parts of Thana’s crux aren’t in the bodies of the kings. It’s in their souls.」——她只握有四分之一。
facts.anchor: The answer is yes and no.

facts.fact: Valentin 狂笑威胁：「once my body is reforged, you never will be」；临去嗅她的恨——「The charred skin sloughing off to reveal the tender new skin of your vengeance. We aren’t so dissimilar after all」——Risha 摔上柜门。
阳台父女：Rath 银发更多了、双手递茶；劝她别回 Mortri——她摔杯反驳：「trust me to be the necromancer you trained」；两度道歉（I’m sorry I changed / I’m sorry you’re frightened of me）。
父亲的答案：「Only frightened for you.」+压低声的「You carry an extra soul」——落如锤击；她答「It’s a soul I accepted willingly...With him, I can survive it again」；Rath 提 gentle exorcise 送 void 等门户重开。
facts.anchor: “I could never be frightened of you, meer piaara.”

facts.fact: 章末天启：太阳升起过快、白金之色带红纹——圆中圆+四象限+Vitaean 元素三角圆纹+Dante 试验用的 rayed suns——他们的太阳成了一座 Conjuration 法阵。
facts.anchor: Their sun had become a Conjuration circle.
